coordinates.meshInventory: Authored prefab scene coordinates; subtract nodes[0].position_m for root-relative coordinates.
coordinates.candidateRegions: Root-relative coordinates after removing prefab scene translation; original scale/rotation retained.

smallFallbackWarning: The geometric calibration is not an alien reactor measurement; these candidates materially reduce some current effective reactor limits and require stock/AI/live validation before any runtime change.

selectionReasons.AlienAssaultCarrier: Separate Tail_C housing at the radiator ring, rather than the aft Engine_A coupler or the long cargo/heart assemblies.
selectionReasons.AlienBattlecruiser: Tail housing surrounding the radiator attachments; restrict allowance to the radiator axial band.
selectionReasons.AlienBattleship: Principal Back housing; exclude Back_Sides framing and wings.
selectionReasons.AlienCruiser: Principal Back housing; exclude the forward Heart cable assembly.
selectionReasons.AlienDestroyer: Body is not a separate reactor chamber; use only its bounded radiator-band geometry, not the whole Body/Guts.
selectionReasons.AlienDreadnought: Outer Tail_E housing at the radiator ring; nested Tail_F coupler is not added as a second bay.
selectionReasons.AlienFrigate: Back housing at radiator attachments; exclude Back_Detail and Back_Sides protrusions.
selectionReasons.AlienLancer: Tail is a 226 m long multipurpose body; do not call the entire mesh a reactor compartment. Clip to its radiator band.
selectionReasons.AlienMonitor: Tail housing at radiator attachments; main/fwd hull is not included.
selectionReasons.AlienTitan: Aft Body_B is a 123 m multipurpose housing; clip to its radiator band and reject the 253 m Heart cable assembly.
selectionReasons.AlienMothership: Three connected Engine_A housings have distinct nonoverlapping transverse extents. Match each to its authored radiator group; exclude inter-pod gaps, fins and the ambiguous Tail_Sphere assembly.
selectionReasons.AlienGunship: No defensible separate reactor housing: nearby parts are named Propellant, Crew and Bridge.
selectionReasons.AlienEscort: No defensible separate reactor housing: Central/Front/Ends meshes divide the general hull, not a clearly isolated machinery bay.
selectionReasons.AlienCorvette: No defensible separate reactor housing: Heart is a thin multi-component cable structure; surrounding geometry is Crew/Bridge/Sides.
selectionReasons.SalamanderGunship: No independent reactor or radiator mesh housing; only general body/head/wings and a built-in thruster. A radiator node alone is not a measured compartment.
